title: 第一卷 第19章 赵千秋第一卷 第20章 大天象诀
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了

三十里的距离。
说近不近，但是说远也不算远，阴轿的速度并不是很快，但是按照李寒舟的计算，在天亮之前肯定是能到松林的。
魄月湖，这是通往松林的必经之路。
魄月湖边。
这里点燃着篝火，将这漆黑的夜给点亮。
在那篝火的旁边坐着一名中年男人，男人的神情很专注的正在擦拭着他的刀。
手中那洁白的手帕，将刀的每一处都给擦拭的非常仔细，那专注的眸子中蕴含着一抹不易觉察的冷血之意。
“出来吧。”
男人此刻头也没抬，只是对着空气淡淡的说了一句。
话音一落，在对面的一处山崖上，一名白衣男子施展轻功飞下，他的身影宛若鬼魅一般，在那天空上拖起一道残影，仿佛万千的分身一般，而下一刻就来到了篝火旁边。
身法之快，简直令人咋舌。
“赵千秋。”白衣男子看着篝火旁边的男人，开口问道：“许久未曾在江湖上听过你的消息，我还以为你已经死了，没想到竟然又出现在神阙国，这次来你是想要做什么？”
“跟你没关系吧。”
赵千秋头也没抬，似乎根本不给这白衣男子的面子。
“起码跟你们太玄圣地没有任何的关系。”赵千秋缓缓道：“不是来找你们太玄圣地的麻烦的，我和你这位太玄圣主井水不犯河水，你没有必要盯着我。”
“你们祭血阁的话能相信？”太玄圣主冷笑一声：“你们祭血阁做过的脏事难道还少吗？更何况你赵千秋一位天罡境的杀手来我太玄圣地的领地，你让我怎么放心。”
“不放心又如何。”赵千秋道：“太玄圣主前段时间大闹西庭洲的事情我也听说了，将般若斧从神牛山给抢了回来。”
“那神牛山可不是什么好地方，神牛山的人可不是吃素的，你抢回般若斧，必定也是付出了一定的代价，回来之后，你太玄圣地举办弟子考核，你都未曾露面，你必定是受了伤，你觉得受了伤你的，我想做什么，你能拦得住我吗？”
太玄圣主听到这话，眼睛顿时眯了下来。

下意识的就后退了半步。
因为赵千秋说的是对的，自己在神牛山的确是受了伤，虽然说已经恢复了不少了，但是高手过招，一点因素都有可能败北。
赵千秋乃是祭血阁的高手，天罡境巅峰的修为，丝毫不比自己弱，真的动起手来，全盛时期固然是不怕，但是现在动手，自己输面非常大。
不过若是他真的打太玄圣地的主意，也没有那么容易，这里毕竟是太玄圣地的地盘，真的拼命的话，他赵千秋也讨不到好。
仿佛觉察到了太玄圣主有那么一丝忌惮，赵千秋轻笑着摇摇头：“放心好了，我懒得和你打，我接的任务目标并不是你，就算是杀了你，也没有人给我钱，我才懒得在你的身上浪费我的时间和力气。”
“你的目标到底是谁？”太玄圣主沉吟一下，问道。
“你管得有点多了。”赵千秋继续擦拭着他的刀。
太玄圣主看向那把刀。
神兵榜三十二位：秋葬。
死在这把刀手中的人不知道有多少。
“有人来了？”就在这个时候，太玄圣主感觉到有两个气息在靠近。
便是此时，赵千秋身影一动，就已经来到附近的一棵古树的树顶上，这漆黑的夜色对于他来说，仿佛没有任何的阻碍。
他的目光宛若鹰隼。
远远的看到两个人正在奔着这边骑马而来。
“不是。”赵千秋皱了皱眉。
而这个时候，太玄圣主也是来到了树顶上，他也看到了奔着这边而来的叶紫樱和李寒舟。
“叶青北的女儿。”太玄圣主看见叶紫樱的时候，就有了印象，小丫头很是灵性，他们太玄圣地当初也很喜欢，只是太玄圣地的功法大开大合，主要以斧法为主，叶紫樱不喜欢，最终去了上清宗。
如今再看叶紫樱，竟然已经是个大姑娘了。
这么大半夜的，叶紫樱这是要做什么去？
至于叶紫樱旁边的那个人，太玄圣主和赵千秋压根都没有关注，一个连半点真气痕迹都没有的人，仅仅是个普通人罢了。

赵千秋转身就准备回去。
他收到的任务是要斩杀很可能出现在神阙国九皇子。

A distance of thirty miles.
It's not close, but it's not too far. The speed of the Yin sedan chair is not very fast, but according to Li Hanzhou's calculations, he will definitely be able to reach the pine forest before dawn.
Poyue Lake is the only way to the pine forest.
By Poyue Lake.
A bonfire is lit here to light up the dark night.
Next to the bonfire sat a middle-aged man, who was wiping his knife with a very focused expression.
The white handkerchief in his hand wiped every part of the knife very carefully, and his focused eyes contained a touch of cold-bloodedness that was not easy to detect.
"Come out."
The man didn't even raise his head at this moment, he just said lightly to the air.
As soon as he finished speaking, on a cliff opposite, a man in white performed Qinggong and flew down. His figure was like a ghost, dragging an afterimage in the sky, like thousands of clones, and the next moment he arrived next to the bonfire.
The speed of the movement is simply staggering.
"Zhao Qianqiu." The man in white looked at the man next to the bonfire and asked, "I haven't heard from you in the world for a long time. I thought you were dead, but I didn't expect you to appear in Shenque Kingdom again. What do you want to do here this time?"
"It has nothing to do with you."
Zhao Qianqiu didn't even raise his head, as if he didn't give the man in white any face at all.
"At least it has nothing to do with your Taixuan Holy Land." Zhao Qianqiu said slowly: "I am not here to cause trouble for your Taixuan Holy Land. I and you, the Taixuan Holy Land, are on the same page, so there is no need for you to keep an eye on me."
"Can you believe what you say from the Blood Sacrifice Pavilion?" Holy Lord Taixuan sneered: "Have you done many dirty things in the Blood Sacrifice Pavilion? Not to mention you, Zhao Qianqiu, a Tiangang realm killer, came to my territory of the Taixuan Holy Land. How can you let me rest assured?"
"So what if you don't worry." Zhao Qianqiu said: "I also heard about how Holy Lord Taixuan made a big fuss in Xitingzhou some time ago and snatched the Prajna Ax back from Shenniu Mountain."
"Then Shenniu Mountain is not a good place. The people of Shenniu Mountain are not vegetarians. You must have paid a certain price for taking back the Prajna Axe. After you came back, you did not show up for the disciple assessment at Taixuan Holy Land. You must have been injured. You feel that you have been hurt. What do I want to do? Can you stop me?"
When Saint Master Taixuan heard this, his eyes suddenly narrowed.
Subconsciously, he took half a step back.
Because what Zhao Qianqiu said was right, he was indeed injured in Shenniu Mountain. Although he had recovered a lot, he could lose due to any factors when masters competed against each other.
Zhao Qianqiu is a master of the Blood Sacrifice Pavilion, and his cultivation at the peak of the Tiangang Realm is no weaker than his own. If he really takes action, he was not afraid in his heyday, but now, he has a huge chance of losing.
But if he really wants to take advantage of Taixuan Holy Land, it won't be that easy. After all, this is the territory of Taixuan Holy Land. If he really tries his best, he, Zhao Qianqiu, won't be able to get any favors from him.
As if aware of the slight fear of Holy Lord Taixuan, Zhao Qianqiu chuckled and shook his head: "Don't worry, I am too lazy to fight you. The target of the mission I took is not you. Even if I kill you, no one will give me money, so I am too lazy to waste my time and energy on you."
"Who is your target?" Saint Master Taixuan pondered for a moment and asked.
"You're overdoing it." Zhao Qianqiu continued to wipe his knife.
Saint Master Taixuan looked at the knife.
Number 32 on the Divine Weapon List: Autumn Burial.
No one knows how many people have died in the hands of this knife.
"Is someone coming?" At this moment, Saint Master Taixuan felt two auras approaching.
At this moment, Zhao Qianqiu moved and reached the top of a nearby ancient tree. The dark night seemed to have no obstacles for him.
His eyes were like those of a hawk.
I saw two people running from a distanceCame here on horseback.
"No." Zhao Qianqiu frowned.
At this time, Holy Master Taixuan also came to the top of the tree, and he also saw Ye Ziying and Li Hanzhou running towards this side.
"Ye Qingbei's daughter." When Taixuan Holy Master saw Ye Ziying, he had an impression. The little girl was very spiritual. They Taixuan Holy Land also liked her very much at first. However, Taixuan Holy Land's skills were very popular, mainly focusing on axe. Ye Ziying didn't like it, so she eventually went to Shangqing Sect.
Looking at Ye Ziying now, she is already a big girl.
What was Ye Ziying going to do in the middle of the night?
As for the person next to Ye Ziying, Saint Taixuan and Zhao Qianqiu didn't pay attention at all. A person without even the slightest trace of true energy was just an ordinary person.
Zhao Qianqiu turned around and prepared to go back.
The mission he received was to kill the ninth prince who was likely to appear in the Shenque Kingdom.
